# monotaur_alarm_note (Resource)

Manages one entry of a Monotaur alarm's incident timeline: what responders are doing (`kind`), in markdown (`body`), and whether the public status page may show it (`public`). Creating a note sends the `com.monotaur.alarm.note-added` webhook event (to webhook subscriptions that opted into it); editing or deleting a note sends no webhook event. A note can be edited, but it belongs to its alarm for life, and it is deleted with the alarm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_monitor" "checkout" {
  name = "Checkout API"
}

resource "monotaur_alarm" "checkout_outage" {
  monitor_id = monotaur_monitor.checkout.id
}

# Creating a note sends the com.monotaur.alarm.note-added webhook event.
resource "monotaur_alarm_note" "update" {
  alarm_id = monotaur_alarm.checkout_outage.id
  kind     = "Investigating"
  body     = "Elevated error rates on **checkout**; the payments team is investigating."
  public   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alarm_id` (String) The ID of the alarm the note belongs to. The API does not allow moving a note to another alarm, so changing it replaces the note (and sends a new `note-added` event). Notes are allowed on closed alarms.
- `body` (String) The note text in markdown (1 to 10,000 characters), stored as sent; rendering and sanitizing it is up to the client.
- `kind` (String) The stage of incident response the note reports: one of `Investigating`, `Mitigating`, `Resolved`. A `Resolved` note does not close the alarm.

### Optional

- `public` (Boolean) Whether the public status page may show the note. Defaults to `false` on the server.

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) Who wrote the note, set by the server from the credential that created it, e.g. `service-account:12`. Edits keep the original author.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the note was created, which is its time on the timeline (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the note (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the note was last updated (assigned by the API).
